Every statue is clothed in carved Greek chiton, peplos or himation drapery, with Greek sandals or carved feet. No contemporary clothes, metal cafe chairs or Roman military uniforms. Arrange them on nine simple separate stone stools/klismos-like stone seats in the same open circle. One statue raises a carved hand in conversation while the other eight lean in or listen. Above them, a suspended bronze oil-lamp bowl hangs from the portico and casts a focused amber pool of light. Clearly an imaginative conversation among sculptures. Their pale stone silhouettes must remain readable in the navy night setting. Match the reference's 2D neo-noir ink linework, two/three flat tonal planes and restrained cool palette, no photographic marble texture.

variants.title: Vienna, circa 1910 · A conversation after dark
variants.brief: Audience and scene: exactly nine adults, men and women roughly 25–65, in a small Viennese courtyard around 1910, during Sigmund Freud's lifetime. An imagined informal intellectual gathering, not a claimed documentary portrait of a historical meeting. Redraw the modern group with historically appropriate early-twentieth-century Central European dress and hairstyles. Men wear dark wool three-piece suits or suit jackets with waistcoats, high-buttoned or stiff-collared shirts, restrained ties, leather lace-up shoes; a mix of neat period mustaches and short beards, one older man with a full beard and small round wire spectacles. Women wear ankle-length tailored skirts, high-neck long-sleeved blouses, fitted walking jackets, pinned-up hair and leather ankle boots. Distinct individual faces and outfits. No flapper bobs, 1920s fringe, miniskirts, modern zippers, hoodies, sneakers or plastic. Nine separate dark bentwood cafe chairs arranged in an open circle. Central speaker makes a small measured hand gesture while the others listen intently. A single tall overhead gas lantern provides the dominant amber light. Adjust the background to a late-Habsburg Viennese apartment courtyard: restrained stucco facades, tall windows, an arched doorway, simple wrought-iron details, cobbled paving. Sparse set dressing, no cigars or text, no clinical couch needed. Deep navy and charcoal clothing, slate architecture, ivory collars, warm natural skin planes and restrained amber highlights. Match the reference's crisp 2D cel-shaded illustrative finish, never sepia photography or a period oil painting.
